responsibilities: The MVP had no scalable way to render varying interfaces across use cases without hardcoding each screen. Architected a server-driven UI system from scratch, letting the backend control interface structure dynamically — reducing the need for new frontend deploys with every product change.

Each client organization needed a distinct branded experience but shared a single codebase. Built authentication, an admin dashboard, and organization-level dynamic theming, enabling multi-tenant customization without duplicating the app per client.

Sales and executive teams were manually coordinating promotions, follow-ups, and scheduling across Telegram, WhatsApp, and email with no central system. Built an orchestrator agent that routed tasks to specialized sub-agents across all three channels for consistent, automated handling.

Sales reps were manually cross-referencing Excel reports, PDFs, and inboxes to prioritize follow-ups, costing hours weekly. Built specialized AI agents with evals and safety checks for Excel sales analytics, PDF promo extraction, and Gmail/Calendar task prioritization, cutting manual reporting and follow-up time by 65%.

The chat interface lacked quick actions and rich formatting, slowing down how users interacted with the AI. Enhanced the chat UI with slash commands (e.g. /fix), @-file includes, and TipTap-based rich text editing for a faster, more capable interaction flow.

Viewers struggled to retain key moments from long live sessions, reducing engagement. Launched AI-generated notes and highlights sourced from live captions, increasing user session duration by 25%.
